<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1312
Claimant:
Ricardo Allen
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
May 23, 2023
Reported a sideswipe wihle changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The claimant is driving, and the vehicle's rear
quarter panel and passenger door show contact damage. The claimant reports a knee injury from striking the
dashboard and has no attorney.
May 30, 2023
Police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene and that the other driver admitted to drifting into
the lane. Two independent witnesses gave statements that match the claimant's account of the collision.
August 15, 2023
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement both support the described impact. Damage to the vehicle is
largely consistent with the reported force of the sideswipe. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records
or the claimant's file.
August 16, 2023
Claimant was seen at an urgent care clinic the same day with knee pain and swelling, and imaging was ordered. The
clinic's intake notes describe the same sequence of events the claimant gave at the scene.
September 23, 2023
Spoke with the claimant by phone to confirm the account, and the claimant described the collision the same way as in
the initial report. The claimant also mentioned a past minor strain in the same knee that resolved fully with rest.
November 11, 2023
A neighbor who was contacted during routine inquiries believes the vehicle had visible damage some weeks before
the reported collision. The neighbor's recollection is not specific about the timing or the location of the damage, so it
needs follow-up.
November 26, 2023
Confirmed the driver lives in the policyholder's household and qualifies as a covered household member under the
policy. Coverage question is resolved on that basis, and the household relationship has been documented in the file.
November 29, 2023
Traetment has increased sharply, with near-daily vsiits to the clinic and physical therapy. Pain has also been reported
in the hip and lower back, which were not mentioned in the first weeks after the collision.
December 6, 2023
Requested the medical records from the treating providers and reviewed the billing summary. Treatment volume is
many times what is typical for this type of knee injury, and the timing of the new complaints is being noted for the file.
December 19, 2023
Account remains consistent across all contacts, and the injury and vehicle damage both fit the reported impact. The
neighbor's comment about earlier damage and the scope of the treatment remain open items, and the file is being
referred for further review before any decision on the injury claim.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
